sub_agent_reviews.summary: Unified Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training and ai-safety in one table; selected arXiv:2608.11110v1 after excluding already published REDAgentBench and other recent releases.
Deep read used arXiv PDF/HTML plus Hugging Face dataset cards, preserving the distinction between symbolic traces, released datasets and the currently empty GitHub repository.
Article states that tools are not executed, the GitHub repository is empty, some subsets require authorized rebuild, and 71-73% retention is bounded to greedy adherent frontier models.
